releaseTitle: WMS v2.14.0 — Popup Input Produksi, Antrean Hitung Ulang & Anti-Freeze Minimize Dock
releaseNotes: Pintasan Dashboard & Popup Luas Input Penerimaan Produksi (bisa minimize, auto-save draft & pelindung offline anti double-input)
